title: Admit or disclose a notes-enabled exchange of an empty project
outcome: Admit or disclose a notes-enabled exchange of an empty project
acceptance: An exchange whose binding profile includes notes on a project with no tasks either succeeds in both directions, using the folder validation and encoding consistently for exchange trees and local bases, or is refused with a stated reason documented as a limit in docs/features/git-task-sync.md
A test covers the incoming {notes_included: true, tasks: []} candidate and the outgoing basis of an empty notes-enabled store
docs/features/git-task-sync.md's 'Internal exchange foundation' section describes the later reconciled import as target behaviour, not in the present tense
